scripts.render:all: clapper render src/index.tsx -c ledger --out out/ledger.mp4 && clapper render src/index.tsx -c orbit --out out/orbit.mp4 && clapper render src/index.tsx -c nimbus --out out/nimbus.mp4 --crf 21
scripts.review: for id in ledger orbit nimbus; do clapper review src/index.tsx -c $id --video out/$id.mp4 || true; done
